# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


# Data
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
tpm <- read_tsv(here("results/rbp/tpm_csf1-transcripts.tsv"))
```

# Isoform information
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# read full kallisto data from one of the experiments and get transcripts
# lengths from there
kal <- read_tsv(tpm$href[1])
isoforms <- kal %>% 
  filter(str_detect(target_id, "\\|CSF1\\|")) %>% 
  separate(target_id,
           into = c("ensembl_transcript_id", "ensembl_gene_id",
                    rep(NA, 7)), 
           sep = "\\|") %>% 
  dplyr::select(ensembl_transcript_id, length)


isoforms <- isoforms %>% 
  mutate(isoform = ifelse(length < 1000, "short", "long"))

# add isoform inform to tpm data
tpm <- left_join(tpm, 
                 select(isoforms, ensembl_transcript_id, isoform),
                 by = "ensembl_transcript_id")

tpm$href <- NULL
```

# Analyze ratios

```{r}
ratios <- tpm %>% 
  group_by(rbp, cell_line, expt_type, expt_accession, 
           tx_quant_accession, rep, isoform) %>% 
  summarise(tpm = sum(tpm)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(rbp, cell_line, expt_type, isoform) %>% 
  summarise(tpm = mean(tpm)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(rbp, cell_line, expt_type),
              names_from = "isoform", 
              values_from = "tpm") %>% 
  mutate(s_vs_l = short/long) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(rbp, cell_line),
              names_from = "expt_type",
              values_from = "s_vs_l") %>% 
  mutate(kd_vs_ctrl = (kd + 0.0001)/(ctrl + 0.0001)) %>% # to prevent Inf values
  arrange(kd_vs_ctrl) %>% 
  mutate(rbp = fct_inorder(rbp)) %>% 
  mutate(log2_kd_vs_ctrl = log2(kd_vs_ctrl))
```

```{r}
#| fig-asp: 3
#| fig-width: 10
ggplot(ratios, aes(log2_kd_vs_ctrl, rbp)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(cell_line)) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
ggplot(ratios, aes(log2(ctrl + 0.0001), log2(kd + 0.0001))) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(cell_line)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggplot(ratios, aes(log2_kd_vs_ctrl)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(cell_line)) +
  theme_bw()
```
